Subject: Regional availability cascade — QBR & roadmap demo (Vantage Health)

Hi Mike / Jessica,

Hope you’re both well. As we approach the renewal QBR, we want to combine the roadmap walkthrough and a focused demo into a single, timeboxed session that works across your US stakeholders. Rather than a single long meeting we’re proposing a sequenced run-of-show with a short exec highlight plus two breakout demos (tech + integration).

Can you share a cadence that works on your side? Rough preference options from our end:
- Option A: Tue Sep 7, 10:00–11:15 PT (exec 15m, product demo 30m, integration 25m, 5m close)
- Option B: Wed Sep 8, 13:00–14:15 PT (same split)
- Option C: Thu Sep 9, staggered 09:00 PT (exec) + 11:30 PT (deep-dive) for east/west regional coverage

If none of those are workable, suggest two windows and we’ll cascade availability across our stakeholders. I’ve attached an agenda and a draft run-of-show so you can see the sequencing.

Thanks —Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vantage_QBR_agenda_v2.pdf (pdf)
